`wger_exerciseinfo_sample.json` holds 13 real exercises in the shape of wger's
`/api/v2/exerciseinfo/` response, rebuilt from the fixture files in the wger project
(https://github.com/wger-project/wger, `wger/exercises/fixtures/`). They were picked to cover
the sync's edge cases: support equipment, no equipment, cardio, "Arms" with no muscles listed,
HTML descriptions and a duplicate name.

wger exercise data is licensed CC-BY-SA 4.0 (https://wger.de).
